user.title: Connect a Savant host
user.description: Home Assistant logs in over SSH once to install its agent and an SSH key. Your password isn't saved.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Savant host.
data_description.username: The login on the Savant host, usually RPM.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to the Savant host again
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant can't log in to {host} as {username} anymore, so it can't update or repair its agent. Enter the password to set up a new key.

reconfigure.title: Change the Savant host connection
reconfigure.description: Change the host address or login. The agent and key get installed again.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the host over SSH.
error.invalid_auth: The host rejected the username or password.
error.unsupported_host: This host's operating system or processor isn't supported: {error}
error.install_failed: Installing the agent on the host failed: {error}
error.agent_unreachable: The agent was installed, but Home Assistant can't reach it: {error}
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Savant host is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Logged in again and the agent is running.

unreachable.title: Can't reach the Savant host at {host}
unreachable.description: Home Assistant can't reach the Savant agent on {host} and couldn't fix it over SSH. Check that the host is on and connected to the network. Home Assistant keeps trying in the background.

service_request.name: Send service request
service_request.description: Send any Savant service request, like a step in a Blueprint workflow.

config_entry_id.name: Savant host
config_entry_id.description: The host to send it to. Uses the first one if left empty.

zone.name: Zone
zone.description: The Savant zone, for example Living Room.

component.name: Component
component.description: The source component, for example Apple TV.

logical_component.name: Logical component
logical_component.description: The logical component, for example Media_server. Some services leave it empty.

service_type.name: Service type
service_type.description: The Savant service type, for example SVC_AV_TV.

request.name: Request
request.description: The request name, for example PowerOn.

arguments.name: Arguments
arguments.description: Arguments for the request, as name and value pairs.
